Label.Tooltip: Your game as a .nup package, or its extracted romfs folder. Either is only read, never changed.

TextInput.Name: romfs_in
TextInput.Placeholder: Game .nup file, or the extracted romfs folder (contains Banc, Event, Pack, RSDB...)

Button.Tooltip: Choose your game's .nup file. Its own exefs is used for the version check.
Choose the extracted romfs folder (or the game folder that holds romfs and exefs).

Label.Name: hash_lab
Label.Tooltip: Hash of your game's executable, used to identify the game version. Select it to copy it into a bug report.

Label.Name: game_lab
Label.Tooltip: The randomizer only runs on game versions it is known to work with. It checks the SHA-256 hash of exefs/main: the one inside the .nup, or the exefs folder next to the romfs folder.

TextInput.Name: out_in
TextInput.Placeholder: Folder the mod package is written to

Button.Tooltip: Playing with Longshot (the PC version)? Finds your Longshot game and writes the seed straight into its mods folder. Older randomizer seeds there are switched off (renamed with _ in front) so only the new one loads. Fills in the game field from the Longshot launcher too, if it's empty.

Button.Text: Scan game — check the game files and load the location list

Label.Text: Launch Game (top right) starts what the output folder belongs to: Longshot for a Longshot mods folder, the emulator for an emulator's load/0400486024DEC000 folder. Leave a field empty to use the one found from the output folder.

Label.Tooltip: The Longshot game folder (with longshot.exe and the mods folder), or the program itself. Empty: the game whose mods folder is the output folder.

TextInput.Name: longshot_in
TextInput.Placeholder: empty = the game next to the output folder

Label.Tooltip: The emulator's program (yuzu, Eden, Citron, Lichii, Ryujinx...) or the folder it is in. Empty: found only for a portable emulator (its user folder next to the program).
Optional: the game the emulator starts right away (its .nsp or .xci file, as you'd open it in the emulator). Empty: the emulator opens to its game list.

Label.Name: saves_lab
Label.Text: Choose a Longshot mods folder or an emulator's load/0400486024DEC000 folder as the output folder to see its seeds.

Button.Tooltip: Switch the selected seed on (every other seed off) and, with Per-Seed Saves, put its own save slots into the game. Close the game first. Double-clicking a seed does the same.

Make the selected seed again with this version's fixes: the same seed number and settings string, so every item stays where it was and your saves still fit. Its own folder is replaced (its stored per-seed saves are kept). Only for seeds made by a version with the same placements. Close the game first.

Label.Text: ▶ = switched on ★ = its saves are in the game

Checkbox.Name: set_create_spoiler
Checkbox.Tooltip: Writes spoiler.txt and spoiler.json next to the mod: where every item is, the hints and the settings.

Checkbox.Name: set_per_seed_saves
Checkbox.Tooltip: Each seed keeps its own save slots, in Longshot and in Switch emulators (Eden, Citron, Lichii and other yuzu-family emulators: set the output folder to the emulator's load/0400486024DEC000 folder). Generating a seed, or Play This Seed on the ROM Options tab, stores the slots you have now with their seed and brings in the new seed's (empty slots for a new one). Slots no seed owns are copied to save_backups first. The game's options are shared. Close the game before switching.

Label.Text: The generator reads what it needs from your own game (.nup or romfs), changes the item placements and writes only the changed files into <output>/<mod name>/romfs. Install that folder as a layered mod (emulator: .../mods/contents/<title id>/<mod name>/romfs, console: atmosphere/contents). Nothing from the game is bundled with this program — share settings strings, not mod folders.
